what: A mechanical review of the committed data and build. Each check states what was compared, the result, and the official page a human should open to confirm it.

checks.finding: The results capture reaches the newest settled game date
checks.evidence: data/origin/games.csv ends 2026-11-14; newest settled game 2026-11-14. The capture is current, so schedule features read from it alone are safe for these dates.

checks.finding: 5 settled games also appear in the results capture; 0 disagree on the final score
checks.evidence: compared game_id, away_pts, home_pts against the verified feed; mismatches: none

checks.finding: Duplicate game_id rows
checks.evidence: 188 rows, 188 unique game_ids, duplicates: none

checks.finding: Same fixture listed twice on the same date
checks.evidence: duplicates: none

checks.finding: A team playing twice on one date
checks.evidence: dates checked: 25; offenders: none

checks.finding: Overtime games present and flagged
checks.evidence: 10 overtime games in 188 rows; e.g. 2026-10-26 MIN 125-127 CLE

checks.finding: Every team code maps to a row in the official standings registry
checks.evidence: 30 codes used, 30 registered, unknown: none

checks.finding: W/L in the advanced capture equals the official standings
checks.evidence: 30 clubs compared; mismatches: none

checks.finding: Games played equals the number of distinct games in the captures
checks.evidence: 188 distinct games unioned from 188 capture rows and 5 settled rows; 0 of 30 clubs differ: none

checks.finding: Accepted player minutes per team reach the regulation total (240, plus OT)
checks.evidence: 10 team-games checked; 3 fall short: [('0022600234', 'BKN', 212.1, 240.0), ('0022600234', 'MEM', 208.4, 240.0), ('0022600235', 'CHI', 171.0, 240.0)]. A shortfall means rows were rejected, and those rows are published with their raw text rather than repaired.

checks.finding: Every player log row carries an official source URL
checks.evidence: 99 rows, 0 without

checks.finding: Every slate team-side has exactly one availability state
checks.evidence: 44 team-sides needed, 44 rows, missing none, duplicated none

checks.finding: Ledger chain verifies and every sealed pick is pre-registered
checks.evidence: entries 11, verified True, unregistered picks none

checks.finding: The model sample ends before the slate it prices (no leakage)
checks.evidence: sample ends 2026-11-14, slate starts 2026-11-15

checks.finding: The possessions-based total differs from the naive scoring-average benchmark
checks.evidence: max |gap| 9.69 pts, mean 4.27 pts. A near-zero gap would mean the 'possessions x PPP' framing adds nothing.

checks.finding: Luck is computed per team and teams outside +/-1.96 are refused
checks.evidence: 30 clubs scored; outside the band: none. No strategy on the site leans on any club, so the refusal has not had to fire yet.

checks.finding: The market-anchored prior is blank rather than a guessed weight
checks.evidence: status NOT COMPUTABLE; blocker recorded: No licensed closing line exists in this repository and the official NBA schedule page does not print prices in the fetch

checks.finding: Travel distance is left blank for venues with no sourced coordinate
checks.evidence: 44 of 44 team-games unverified; arena_coords.json is not populated

checks.finding: No club has both a captured log and an announced absence
checks.evidence: captured 10 clubs, absences at 11 clubs, overlap 8

checks.finding: Every generated page carries at least one official https source
checks.evidence: 18 pages built; without a source: none

checks.finding: The site build is deterministic
checks.evidence: two consecutive runs were byte-identical on all 15 pages (md5 of the concatenated checksums); CI re-runs the whole pipeline and fails on any diff against the committed tree

checks.finding: Consecutive official reports differ only by spelling corrections
checks.evidence: 3 consecutive pairs, 0 status changes, 58 rows added as renames (Embid/Embiid, Bogoljub/Bogojub). A name-keyed ledger would silently miss these.
